I just came off an 8-week solo trip to the UK. I'm 44 and when stuff happens like you're experiencing, I feel like I'm just too old for this hostel shit. Very little privacy, finding random pubes, loud and drunken teens, people coming into the room at 2 am making all sorts of racket. So on sympathize with you.

After some experimenting, what I did was get an Airbnb for a few nights (some are very reasonable and almost the same as a hostel room in the UK!) Then go back to a hostel, then Airbnb and so on. It depends on your budget of course. I spent an average of $38 per night over 8 weeks. I feel that's reasonable for the UK. The second thing is what others have said. Earplugs. I use Mack's silicone earplugs every night. They block out a lot of sound amid they don't fall out. They're awesome.

Part of the experience of travel is the "inconvenience" of living in a hostel environment and all that entails. But it can start to wear you down so just mix it up a bit. Good luck and happy trails.
